responsibility: Generates `insn-target-def.h`, the target-hook wrapper layer for target-specific instruction generators. It matches `target-insns.def` entries to machine-description `define_insn`/`define_expand` patterns, emits `target_have_*`, `target_gen_*`, and `TARGET_*` macros, and synthesizes wrappers that convert generated RTL into `rtx_insn *` sequences when needed.
